title: 31 August 1961: Live: St John's Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ 10th performance at St John’s Hall on Snaefell Avenue in Tuebrook, Liverpool.

Mona Best, mother of Pete and owner of the Casbah Coffee Club, also ran some nights at St John’s Hall. The venue shouldn’t be confused with a hall in Bootle of the same name where The Beatles also performed.

The Beatles played at Liverpool’s St John’s Hall on 11 occasions. The other dates were 17 February; 10 March; 13, 20 and 27 July; 3, 10, 17 and 24 August; and 8 September 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1963: The Beatles live: Odeon Cinema, Southport
